name: Finland — Finnish parties
intro: compare it with Finnish political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Finland: those represented in the parliament (Eduskunta) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Eduskunta) after the 2023 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 200 members.

Vas.name: Vasemmistoliitto
Vas.priorities: Welfare state, Climate action, Workers' rights and wages
Vas.description: Left Alliance, which grew strongly in the 2024 European election; it defends the welfare state, trade unions and climate action.

Vihr.name: Vihreä liitto
Vihr.description: Green League, unusual among European greens for supporting nuclear power.

SDP.name: Suomen Sosialidemokraattinen Puolue
SDP.priorities: Welfare state, Workers' rights and wages, Public healthcare
SDP.description: Social Democratic Party, the main opposition force, which leads recent polls.

Volt.name: Volt Suomi
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

Kesk.name: Suomen Keskusta
Kesk.priorities: Regions and rural services, Farmers and rural areas, Welfare state
Kesk.description: Centre Party, rooted in rural Finland and agrarian politics.

RKP.name: Svenska folkpartiet / Ruotsalainen kansanpuolue
RKP.priorities: Rights of the national minority, Education, Deeper European integration
RKP.description: Swedish People's Party, the liberal party of Finland's Swedish-speaking minority.

Kok.name: Kansallinen Kokoomus
Kok.priorities: Fiscal discipline, Competitiveness and growth, Defence and support for Ukraine
Kok.description: National Coalition Party of Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, which leads a right-wing government focused on cutting debt and reforming the labour market.

KD.name: Suomen Kristillisdemokraatit
KD.priorities: Traditional family values, Christian values, Pensions and the elderly
KD.description: Christian Democrats, socially conservative and part of the government.

PS.name: Perussuomalaiset
PS.ideologies: National conservatism, Right-wing populism, Euroscepticism, Anti-immigration
PS.priorities: Reducing immigration, Fiscal discipline, National sovereignty
PS.description: Finns Party, nationalist and Eurosceptic, in government since 2023 with a strict line on immigration.
